text: yanxu-dsh-plugin 是面向 DSH 的编码交付工作流技能插件：它通过 skills 接口注册可由用户或模型加载的 Yanxu Dev 技能。技能引导代理检查仓库准备状态、建立需求任务契约、按显式文件许可范围生成代码并执行指定测试，随后整理 PR 与 CI 证据、审阅草稿 PR，并以匹配任务测量效率。适合希望把编码请求限制在可审查步骤中的 DSH 用户；使用前需在目标环境安装 Yanxu Dev。

yanxu-dsh-plugin adds a Yanxu Dev skill to DSH. It guides coding through repository checks, a task contract, an explicit file allowlist, testing, and reviewable PR and CI evidence. It covers draft PR boundaries and matched-task efficiency measurement. Install Yanxu Dev in the target environment.
想让编码任务先检查仓库状态并写清需求范围。
希望 AI 只修改我明确允许的源文件，并执行指定测试。
Help me gather reviewable PR and CI evidence for a coding task.
yanxu-dsh-plugin 的功能「分阶段编码交付」：技能先运行仓库诊断并建立任务契约，再依据显式源文件许可范围生成代码并执行指定测试；输出保存在隔离的 HEAD 归档中供人工审阅。
yanxu-dsh-plugin 的功能「PR 与效率证据指导」：技能要求人工审阅生成报告后再走常规 Git 流程，并区分草稿 PR、CI、合并与部署；效率结论需基于至少五个匹配且质量通过的真实任务。

yanxu-dsh-plugin README · Yanxu Dev DSH Plugin：`yanxu-dsh-plugin` is an installable [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Bundle. It adds one model- and user-loadable skill, `yanxu-delivery-workflow`, for using [Yanxu Dev](https://github.com/guannan1031/yanxu-dev) as an evidence-bound AI coding delivery workflow.

yanxu-dsh-plugin README · Yanxu Dev DSH Plugin：The skill guides an agent through repository readiness, requirement contracts, explicit source allowlists, isolated tests, PR/CI evidence, Draft PR boundaries and measured efficiency. It deliberately uses DSH's existing `bash` or `pwsh` tools, so command execution stays inside the Harness permission and sandbox model.

yanxu-dsh-plugin README · Install：Install the public GitHub release into a DSH profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:guannan1031/yanxu-dsh-plugin#v0.1.0
```

Restart that profile after installation. DSH adds the package to the profile's bundle list because this package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`.

For a local checkout during development:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/yanxu-dsh-plugin
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```
yanxu-dsh-plugin README · Install：The configuration dump must include a `yanxu-dsh-plugin` layer before use.
yanxu-dsh-plugin README · Use：In DSH, load the skill named `yanxu-delivery-workflow`, then ask the agent to work on an authorized repository. The skill requires it to:

yanxu-dsh-plugin README · Use：1. Run `doctor` and create a task contract before AI code generation.
2. Use an explicit source-file allowlist and test command for `implement`.
3. Keep generated changes in the isolated archive until human review.
4. Treat Draft PR, CI success, merge, and deployment as separate states.
5. Measure developer-efficiency claims with matched, quality-passing real tasks.

yanxu-dsh-plugin README · Use：Yanxu Dev itself must be installed in the target project environment. Follow its [Windows guide](https://github.com/guannan1031/yanxu-dev/blob/main/docs/WINDOWS_SETUP.md) or repository README.

yanxu-dsh-plugin README · What this plugin does not do：It does not bypass DSH permissions, run arbitrary host processes from the plugin process, store credentials, automatically merge a PR, or deploy an application. It supplies workflow instructions; DSH's existing sandboxed tools execute any approved commands.

yanxu-dsh-plugin README · Verify：```bash
npm test
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

The first command validates the bundle's exported contract. The second proves that DSH has composed the bundle layer. A normal `dsh` session should list `yanxu-delivery-workflow` in its skills catalog.

yanxu-dsh-plugin README · Discovery：The repository is tagged with GitHub topic `dsh-plugin`, which community DSH marketplaces use for discovery. The official DSH installation mechanism is `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <package-or-git-spec>`; no official central registry has been used for this release.
